Ravi P (Product): Quick sync - need GA guardrails sign-off today: SLA buckets, monitoring acceptance, docs + runbooks, pricing safety nets. Short and actionable.

Nadia T (ENG): OK. SLA buckets: small <=512, medium 513-2048, long >2048. Will propose p95: small<150ms, medium<280ms, long<600ms for hosted.

Jon W (SRE): Monitoring checklist: synthetic probes NA/EU/APAC, end-to-end tracing, per-model token telemetry, alerts for p95 and 5xx. Error rate target <0.25% daily.

Evan K (FinOps): Pricing guardrail: pilot cap = 0.8x current-hosted baseline per 1k tokens. Flag if projected GA cost >1.1x. I'll publish a 3-scenario table (base/high/extreme).

Maya R (Docs): I'll slot the final SLA table into docs. Also drafting quickstart, rollback steps, and runbook snippets (will include exact curl examples).

Sam O (Ops): Oncall/runbook: rota for first 14 days must be posted and playbook drill scheduled. Need emergency fallback commands confirmed.

deploy-bot: Staging smoke passed @1743300300. CI: https://ci.internal/jobs/1743300300

Ravi P (Product): Owners: @Nadia SLA + metrics, @Jon monitoring + alerts, @Maya docs + runbook, @Evan pricing scenarios + exceptions, @Sam oncall + drills. I'll assemble and ask for sign-off at 16:00. Any blockers?

Nadia T (ENG): SLA numbers into planning doc by 11:00.

Evan K (FinOps): Pricing scenarios by 13:00.

Jon W (SRE): Monitoring checklist and alert thresholds by EOD. Scheduling 72h burn-in in staging with ENG.

Maya R (Docs): Docs skeleton by 17:00.

Sam O (Ops): Rota published before GA cut. No blockers now.

Ravi P (Product): Thanks all. If nothing changes I will publish the GA guardrails in the playbook at 16:00. :thumbsup:
